description: All 14 V Rising weapon types with PvE/PvP tier rankings, skills, and playstyle data. Sourced from in-game testing on Invaders of Oakveil patch.

weapons.name: Reaper

q.name: Howling Reaper
q.description: Wide arc spin attack hitting all enemies in 360° radius

e.name: Tendon Swing
e.description: Slowing attack that reduces enemy movement speed

strengths: Best AoE farming weapon in the game
Howling Reaper clears entire camps in 2-3 swings
Ranged auto-attacks allow kiting
Wide hitbox forgives positioning errors
weaknesses: Low single-target DPS compared to Spear/Longbow
Slow attack speed
Mediocre in PvP — human opponents avoid wide arcs easily
bestFor: Co-op play where someone else handles single-target

weapons.name: Longbow

q.name: Arrow Rain
q.description: Rains arrows in target area, dealing sustained damage over time

e.name: Focus Shot
e.description: Charged piercing shot with bonus damage at full Focus stacks

strengths: Highest single-target DPS at full Focus stacks
Safest weapon — engage from 2+ screens away
Piercing shots hit multiple lined-up enemies
S-tier in both PvE and PvP
weaknesses: Immobile while firing — vulnerable to gap closers in PvP
No innate defensive skills
Requires positioning knowledge
bestFor: Learning new boss mechanics from safe distance

weapons.name: Spear

q.name: Thousand Spears
q.description: Rapid multi-hit thrust dealing massive burst damage at close range

e.name: Harpoon
e.description: Pulls target toward you, repositioning bosses and PvP targets

strengths: Best boss-killing weapon — Thousand Spears at close range is unmatched burst
Harpoon repositions enemies
Defense shred pairs with Warrior blood
S-tier in both PvE and PvP
weaknesses: Linear attacks miss mobile targets
Requires close range for Thousand Spears
No innate AoE outside Thousand Spears
bestFor: Players who prefer burst windows over sustained DPS

weapons.name: Slasher

q.name: Elusive Strike
q.description: Dash attack with invisibility frames and reposition

e.name: Camouflage
e.description: Turn invisible, next attack deals bonus damage from stealth

strengths: PvP meta — stealth engage into bleed combo
Invisibility (Camouflage) for surprise attacks
Armor-expose synergy with Rogue blood
Hardest to predict in PvP
weaknesses: Lower raw damage than Claws or Greatsword
Weaker without stealth opener
B-tier in PvE — mobs don't fall for stealth

weapons.name: Pistols

q.name: Icebringer
q.description: Ice shots that build freeze stacks on target

e.name: Chaos Barrage
e.description: Rapid-fire multiple shots in a cone

strengths: Fire while moving — only weapon that deals damage while dodging
Consistent mid-range DPS
Icebringer + Chaos Barrage for PvP pressure
Good for kiting slow melee bosses
weaknesses: Shorter range than Longbow or Crossbow
Lower burst than Greatsword or Spear
Requires good movement to maximize value
bestFor: Players who prefer movement over positioning

weapons.name: Twinblade

q.name: Cyro Field
q.description: Creates a freezing field that slows and damages enemies

e.name: Multi-Slash
e.description: Fast multi-hit combo that procs freeze faster than any other weapon

strengths: Fastest freeze proc with Frost Amulet
Multi-hit attacks trigger on-hit effects rapidly
Good mobility
Unique playstyle not replicated by any other weapon
weaknesses: Lower raw damage per hit
Requires Frost Amulet for full potential
Oakveil expansion required

weapons.name: Greatsword

q.name: Spin Slash
q.description: 360° spin attack, excellent for clearing adds during boss fights

e.name: Lunge
e.description: Closes distance and applies 30% slow for 2 seconds

strengths: Highest single-hit damage — charged heavy deals 250-400% weapon damage
Massive burst combo (E → Q → charged heavy → Heart Strike)
Tanky by nature — higher base defense multiplier
Devastating in PvP as a punisher — one mistake = death
weaknesses: Slow swing speed — vulnerable during charged attacks
Predictable in PvP — skilled opponents dodge charged heavy
Poor at multi-target sustained DPS
Gets kited easily by ranged builds
bestFor: Players who prefer patience and timing over aggression

weapons.name: Sword

q.name: Whirlwind
q.description: Spin attack hitting all enemies around you

e.name: Shockwave
e.description: Ground projectile traveling forward, hitting enemies in a line

strengths: Most forgiving moveset — best beginner weapon
Whirlwind gives solid AoE clearing
Easy to craft at all tiers
Balanced damage and defense
weaknesses: Outclassed by specialized weapons at higher tiers
Excels at nothing specific
Lower peak performance than all S/A-tier weapons

weapons.name: Whip

q.name: Harvest Moon
q.description: Pulls enemies toward you, excellent PvP engage setup

e.name: Death From Above
e.description: Leap into the air and strike down, dealing AoE damage

strengths: 2-second entangle from range — excellent setup for teammates
Harvest Moon pull engages for PvP
Unique ranged control niche
weaknesses: Lower damage output than other ranged weapons
Niche PvE use
Relies on team coordination for full value

weapons.name: Crossbow

q.name: Lightning Arrow
q.description: Electric arrow that chains between enemies

e.name: Fan of Bolts
e.description: Fires multiple bolts in a cone

strengths: Good AoE with Lightning Arrow chaining
Faster fire rate than Longbow
Decent for boss fights with adds
Faster Scholar cooldown reset procs than Longbow
weaknesses: Outclassed by Longbow in most scenarios
Lower single-target DPS
Shorter range than Longbow

weapons.name: Claws

q.name: Flurry
q.description: 5-7 rapid hits in ~1.5 seconds. Fastest on-hit trigger in the game

e.name: Pounce
e.description: Longest gap closer in the game — nearly 2x range of other weapon dashes

strengths: Highest mobility in the game
Fastest on-hit trigger for Rogue/Scholar procs
Stickiest weapon — targets cannot escape
Best 1v1 PvP weapon
weaknesses: Squishy — no innate defense or sustain
Highest skill floor of any weapon
Short range in PvE holds it back
Poor AoE clear

weapons.name: Mace

q.name: Crushing Blow
q.description: Heavy overhead smash with bonus damage to ore nodes and constructs

e.name: Smack
e.description: Stunning blow that interrupts enemy actions

strengths: Crushing Blow deals bonus damage to ore nodes — best resource gathering weapon
Stun-lock potential vs single targets
Niche freeze chain potential with specific builds
weaknesses: Slow and clunky without full freeze build
Outclassed by Greatsword for melee burst
Outclassed by Spear for single-target
Poor in PvP — too slow to hit human opponents
bestFor: Players who prefer stun-locking single targets

weapons.name: Axe

q.name: Frenzy
q.description: Attack speed self-buff. Increases swing speed for duration

e.name: X-Slash
e.description: Cross-shaped slash hitting enemies in front

strengths: Frenzy attack speed buff
Decent early game farming
Easy to use
weaknesses: Outclassed by Spear and Reaper at higher tiers
Lacks unique identity
Frenzy is its only standout trait
No scaling advantage into late game
bestFor: Players who haven't found their preferred weapon yet

weapons.name: Throwing Daggers

q.name: Spinning Blade
q.description: Fan attack throwing multiple daggers in a spread pattern

e.name: Shadow Step
e.description: Short teleport with dagger recall damage

strengths: Unique flavor as thrown weapon
Some PvP kiting potential with Rogue blood
weaknesses: Slow ranged attacks with long recovery frames
Longbow does everything better
D-tier in PvP
The one weapon to avoid entirely for serious play
